svg.title: A merge request that only changes deployment files does not wait for the test suite: Plan synchronizes the deployment policy with bounded recovery
svg.text: A merge request that only changes deployment files does
not wait for the test suite
Scenario: Plan synchronizes the deployment policy with bounded recovery

g.text: Given a default branch plan with a project API token and deployment
This isolated GitLab project uses trunk as its default branch and an API-scoped project
Then plan publishes and verifies the deployment policy in GitLab
The project variable exists, is raw, and is available to merge request pipelines. Repeating plan is a verified no-op.
Then a later default branch plan repairs the policy even without a configuration change
Synchronization runs on every eligible plan, including after a temporary stale value.
Then temporary failures retry within bounds while obsolete or unauthorized plans cannot
A controlled transport and clock exercise API outages, credentials failures and concurrent branch movement. Live API

svg.text: Storyboard e2e · 4 steps · 4 frames · every frame is its own pixel baseline (tolerance: 0)
● Given: stage ● When: actions ● Then: proofs
